title: Network shares are being opened up in the browser rather than Explorer
author: trajano
summary: PowerToys Run routes a bare UNC server path such as `\\nas` to URI Handler/browser instead of returning the network server through the Folder plugin, while a full share path works.
next_action: Reproduce the bare UNC root and verify plugin ownership and ranking for `\\server` versus `\\server\share`.

confidence.rationale: The thread isolates the failing input and the two competing plugins precisely.

judgment.rationale: The reporter and maintainer narrowed the failure to a bare UNC server root and identified the competing URI Handler and Folder plugin results.
evidence: Explorer opens `\\nas` and enumerates shares correctly.
PowerToys Run's URI Handler offers a browser action for the bare server path.
A full path such as `\\nas\Videos` works once the share name is valid; only server-root enumeration remains broken.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce the bare UNC root and verify plugin ownership and ranking for `\\server` versus `\\server\share`.

fix_assessment.rationale: The current plugin ownership behavior must be verified before choosing between URI filtering and network-share enumeration.

issue_context.summary: PowerToys Run routes a bare UNC server path such as `\\nas` to URI Handler/browser instead of returning the network server through the Folder plugin, while a full share path works.
known_information: The original affected version is PowerToys 0.72.0.
The reporter supplied screenshots of the wrong URI result and expected folder result.
inferences: URI Handler accepts the UNC root while Folder plugin requires a resolved share path and does not enumerate the server root.
issue_context.analysis: A current plugin-result comparison can determine whether URI filtering, Folder enumeration, or result ranking needs change.
initial_investigation: Read the full issue and all seven comments.
Confirmed the discussion already isolates `\\nas` from valid `\\nas\share` paths.

actions.label: Reproduce bare UNC server routing
actions.note: Maintainer-side verification only; this artifact performs no upstream write.

reproduce.title: Compare URI and Folder results for UNC roots
prerequisites: A reachable SMB server with at least one share
setup: Confirm `\\server` opens and lists shares in File Explorer.
steps: Enter `\\server` in PowerToys Run and record every result and owning plugin.
Invoke the top result and record whether it opens Explorer or a browser.
Disable URI Handler temporarily and repeat the bare-server query to test Folder plugin enumeration.
reproduce.expected_result: A bare UNC server root is owned by a file-system result that opens Explorer and is never offered as a browser URI.
